newPipeline.alignmentReferenceChecks: Both prepared BAMs matched the selected FASTA names, lengths and M5 sequence hashes.
newPipeline.outputs: GATK-filtered VCF and PASS-only VCF feed actual BCFtools statistics and separate attributed HTML sections.
newPipeline.provenance: Frozen version pins, planned/completed methods, diagram, named report attribution; pipeline and preset omit specimen bindings.
newPipeline.pathCheck: Actual commands executed from a temporary folder containing spaces.

validation: Real declared pack argv; SAMtools and BCFtools run their packaged APE binaries through pinned APE loader; only Java is replaced by pinned matching Linux runtime. This is not native Windows execution evidence.
constraints: Distinct tumor and normal names; distinct physical file paths including hardlinks; header SM matches chosen sample.
VCF INFO AF requires Number=A and Type=Float; this is a header contract, not a guarantee for all record values or population/reference suitability.
Finite decimal contamination between 0 and 1; exact user string retained; this pack does not estimate contamination.
